# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P73](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0073)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>

## Appearance

He glares sternly when disciplining students in his classroom.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)_

## Personality

He is a strict, unfair, and somewhat ineffective teacher who carries matters with a heavy hand. He frequently ignores the general classroom noise to give individual attention to older students, particularly Prissy Andrews. He can be harsh and unperceptive toward his pupils' feelings.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038)_

## Traits

- Strict  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- Unfair  <sub>[v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching Latin and algebra  <sub>[v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster at Avonlea school. During his time teaching, he paid special attention to Prissy Andrews, often helping her with Latin and algebra problems while the rest of the scholars behaved as they pleased. He punished Gilbert Blythe and Ruby Gillis for classroom disruptions, and he famously called Anne Shirley 'Carrots' and punished her by making her sit with the boys, causing Anne to refuse to return to his school for a time. Although not considered an exceptionally good teacher by some, his pupils still made academic progress under his instruction. Upon his eventual departure from the Avonlea school, some students weeping was noted.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P73](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0073), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)_
